quarterly_data.quarter: Vicor press release: USITC Institutes Investigation of Vertical Power Delivery (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Vicor IP enforcement (per Vicor's release): on October 9, 2026 the U.S. International Trade Commission (USITC) voted to institute an investigation, based on a complaint by Vicor of violations of section 337 of the Tariff Act, into the importation and sale for importation of Vertical Power Delivery (VPD) systems, components thereof and computing systems that infringe claims of an asserted patent; Vicor requested a Limited Exclusion Order (LEO) and cease and desist orders. Respondents identified by the USITC: Delta Electronics, Infineon Technologies, Luxshare Precision Industry, Monolithic Power Systems, Flex, Celestica, Quanta Computer, Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn) and Ingrasys Technology. Vicor says OEMs and hyperscalers whose computing systems include VPD components sourced from Respondents will need a license from Vicor to import otherwise infringing systems into the United States, and that VPD royalty rates depend on the stage of enforcement, escalating as the investigation advances to a Limited Exclusion Order.
